lines.en: label yumislumber2:
scene chickenscene1
: Oh. Okay. Guess I’ll just go fuck myself.
lines.zh: : 哦。行。那我就自己滚一边去吧。

lines.en: : Hi~ Did you come all the way over here just to surprise me?
lines.zh: : 嗨~你大老远跑过来，就是为了给我个惊喜吗？

lines.en: : Yes. You got me.
lines.zh: : 对。被你抓到了。

lines.en: : That’s so sweet. And it makes me forget all about how you haven’t responded to me all morning.
lines.zh: : 太贴心了。这样一来我就能完全忘记你一上午都没回我消息的事了。

lines.en: : I didn’t have my phone on me.
lines.zh: : 我手机没带在身上。

lines.en: : Ooh...So that hard lump I’m feeling in your pants right now is...
lines.zh: : 哦哟……那我现在在你裤子里摸到的这块硬硬的东西是……

lines.en: scene chickenscene2
: That...would be my penis.
lines.zh: : 那……应该是我的阴茎。

lines.en: : It feels more rectangular than normal.
lines.zh: : 手感比一般的要方一些。

lines.en: : That’s the way it’s always been. I'm sensitive about it.
lines.zh: : 它一直都长这样。我对这事挺敏感的。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Kiss me.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。亲我。

lines.en: : We probably shouldn’t in front of company-
lines.zh: : 有外人在场，我们大概不该——

lines.en: scene chickenscene3
: Chu~
: Oh, come on! Not at the table! I eat there! And even your boyfriend tried turning it down! That’s basically assault!
lines.zh: : 喂，别这样！别在餐桌上！我在那儿吃饭的！而且连你男朋友都想拒绝了！这基本上就是性骚扰！

lines.en: scene chickenscene4
When in Rome, I guess.
lines.zh: 入乡随俗吧，我想。

lines.en: : Mmf...mm...mhlm~
lines.zh: : 唔……嗯……唔嗯~
: 嗯啊……嗯……嗯~

lines.en: scene chickenscene5
: Okay, I’m done. Just needed to recharge my battery a little.
lines.zh: : 好啦，我结束了。只是得充充电而已。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, that’s all I can do today as I’ve gotta take care of Chinami now. Which means having you get the heck out of here.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，今天我只能做到这一步了，因为现在得去照顾 Chinami。也就是说，你得赶紧滚出去了。

lines.en: scene chickenscene6
: Wait, you sure? I've got shit under control, you know. Ain’t so much as let her out from behind the curtain all day.
lines.zh: : 等等，你确定吗？我这边都搞定了啊。我一整天都没让她从帘子后面出来过。

lines.en: : And you’ve been a big help, but she’s still my responsibility. And now that I’m done with work, you can go do something you actually enjoy instead of being cooped up in here all day.
lines.zh: : 你帮了大忙，但她始终是我的责任。现在我也下班了，你可以去做点自己真正喜欢的事，别整天闷在这儿。

lines.en: : But...I don’t enjoy anything. This is what I do.
lines.zh: : 可……我不喜欢任何事。这就是我平时干的。

lines.en: : Why not hang out with Sensei, then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不跟老师出去玩？

lines.en: scene chickenscene7
: Great idea, Chika. But I’m only okay with this because it was your idea and I would never go out of my way to seek out Yumi on my own.
lines.zh: : 好主意，Chika。我之所以同意，只是因为这是你提的，我自己是绝不会特地去找 Yumi 的。

lines.en: : Can it. I know you guys are friends.
lines.zh: : 少来了。我知道你们是朋友。

lines.en: : We are not! Just kick him outta here and I can chill with you and Chinami instead!
lines.zh: : 我们才不是！把他赶出去，我就能跟你和 Chinami 一起待着了！

lines.en: : Mmm...no. Take a day off. We still don’t even know how she got sick in the first place. What if it was you? We were all at the beach yesterday, so it’s possible something might’ve come home with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不行。休息一天吧。我们还不知道她到底是怎么病的。万一源头是你呢？昨天我们都在海边，说不定你带什么回来了。

lines.en: : It was probably that fuckin’ brat and her mom when they came over here to watch her yesterday! Why’s it gotta be me?!
lines.zh: : 八成是昨天那个小屁孩和她妈过来照看她时带的！凭什么怪我？！

lines.en: : You’ve seen the Tsukiokas' place, haven’t you? They’re all total clean freaks. Touka washes her hands after basically every single thing she touches.
lines.zh: : 你见过月冈家吧？他们一家都有洁癖。Touka 基本上摸过什么都要洗手。

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika——

lines.en: : Why even fight me on this? Just go for a walk around the block or something. It’s really no big deal.
lines.zh: : 干嘛非要跟我争？去街区附近走走什么的。真没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : If that is what must be done...
lines.zh: : 既然非这么做不可的话……

lines.en: scene black
: No more excuses! Besides, if you two start spending a little more time together, you might not feel pressured to always put on an act in front of me!
lines.zh: : 别再找借口了！再说了，你们俩要是多待在一起，也许就不用老在我面前装模作样了！

lines.en: : It ain’t an act! I seriously despise the dude!
lines.zh: : 才不是装！我是真的讨厌这家伙！

lines.en: : But just yesterday you said we’d be best friends forever.
lines.zh: : 可你昨天还说我们要做一辈子的好朋友。

lines.en: : Stop playing along!
lines.zh: : 别跟着起哄！

lines.en: Somehow, Chika manages to force the two of us out of the house so she can take care of her sister. And while it’s not quite how I envisioned this going, I take it as a sort of blessing in disguise.
lines.zh: Chika 总算把我和她一起赶出了门，好让她照顾妹妹。虽然跟我设想的不太一样，但我也把它当成一种变相的好事。

lines.en: Surprisingly enough, Yumi doesn’t take off running as soon as the front door opens. Which tells me she is currently facing one of the following predicaments.
lines.zh: 令人意外的是，前门一开 Yumi 并没有撒腿就跑。这说明她眼下正面临以下几种困境之一。

lines.en: Option A) She actually does want to hang out with me. (This is the least likely option)
lines.zh: 选项 A）她其实是真的想跟我在一起。（这个可能性最低）

lines.en: Option B) She is dumbfounded by her best friend’s newfound affinity for aggressively thrusting the two of us together and simply doesn’t have it in her to run. (This is the most likely option)
lines.zh: 选项 B）她被自己好朋友那股新养成的、硬要把我们俩往一起推的劲头震住了，根本没力气跑。（这个可能性最高）

lines.en: Or Option C) She’s going to give me more time to try and explain exactly what I need from her and what she has to do next.
lines.zh: 或者选项 C）她打算给我更多时间，让我试着说清我需要她做什么、她接下来该怎么做。

lines.en: I’d be happy with either A or C, but it’s C that would make all of this a thousand times easier. And it’s C that has the greatest potential to fail.
lines.zh: A 或 C 我都能接受，但 C 会让这一切轻松千倍。而 C 也最有可能落空。

lines.en: scene chickenscene8
Which is why it’s important I choose my next words wisely.
lines.zh: 所以接下来的话，我必须谨慎选择。

lines.en: For in the silent walk from Point A to Point B, the slow, vine-like creep of an unfortunate realization begins to entangle my limbs.
lines.zh: 因为在从 A 点走到 B 点的沉默中，一个不幸的念头像藤蔓一样慢慢爬上来，缠住了我的手脚。

lines.en: This realization has naught to do with a task that I have been given nor the now-ingrained responsibility to move things forward-
lines.zh: 这个念头与被派给我的任务无关，也和那种已经根深蒂固的、要推动事情向前发展的责任无关——

lines.en: The thing that I unfortunately realize is that I am afraid of losing Yumi.
lines.zh: 我不幸意识到的是：我害怕失去 Yumi。

lines.en: And that even if a new one were to spawn in her place, without memories the universe deems as flawed or unnecessary, she would only be a shell of her former self.
lines.zh: 即便在她原来的位置上一个全新的她诞生，没有那些被这个宇宙判定为有缺陷或多余的记忆，她也不过是从前的自己的一具空壳。

lines.en: The real Yumi knows something is wrong, she just doesn’t know why or how or where to go from here. And neither do any of us.
lines.zh: 真正的 Yumi 知道有什么不对劲，只是不知道为什么、怎么回事、接下来该往哪儿走。而我们谁也不知道。

lines.en: But if you take that away, she’s just like everyone else again.
lines.zh: 可要是把这点也拿走，她就又和别人没什么两样了。

lines.en: She’s no longer an outlier.
lines.zh: 她就不再是异常值了。

lines.en: And while some people might feel more comfortable with that, I am not one of them.
lines.zh: 虽然有些人可能会因此觉得更自在，但我不是那种人。

lines.en: The most unfortunate part of this unfortunate realization is how unfortunate it is that I’ve been neglecting that all along.
lines.zh: 这个不幸的念头里最不幸的一点是：我竟然一直都在忽视它。

lines.en: And that many of the bodies I have taken under the covers of my bed have been nothing more than factory-painted, plastic Easter eggs.
lines.zh: 我曾带上床的那么多身体，也不过是一个个工厂上色的塑料复活节彩蛋。

lines.en: They may all look the same, but they are all empty.
lines.zh: 它们看起来都一样，但全都是空的。

lines.en: And this egg still has the potential to hatch.
lines.zh: 而这枚蛋仍有孵化的可能。

lines.en: Or sour.
lines.zh: 或者变臭。

lines.en: Whatever comes first.
lines.zh: 哪个先来就算哪个。

lines.en: : We just gonna fuckin’ sit here?
lines.zh: : 我们就这么干坐着？

lines.en: : For now. It’s not like either one of us knows what to talk about.
lines.zh: : 暂时如此。反正我们俩谁都不知道该聊什么。

lines.en: : Not gonna keep trying to coerce me into...sleeping at your house or whatever the fuck was going on back at Chika’s place?
lines.zh: : 你不打算继续逼我……去你家睡觉，或者刚才在 Chika 家说的那堆狗屁？

lines.en: : A change of strategies is in order if you’re ever going to go along with it. I just haven’t figured out what the new strategy entails yet.
lines.zh: : 要是想让你答应，我得换个策略。只是我还没想好新策略具体是什么。

lines.en: : We can just stay quiet in the meantime while I work that out in my head.
lines.zh: : 在那之前我们可以就这么安静待着，我在脑子里琢磨。

lines.en: : The fact that you’re callin’ it a “strategy” tells me pretty much all I need to hear. Still ain’t got any interest in coming to your house and that ain’t gonna change.
lines.zh: : 你把它叫「策略」，光这一点就够我听明白了。我还是没兴趣去你家，这一点也不会变。

lines.en: : It’s really not how it sounds, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 真不是你听起来的那样，Yumi。

lines.en: : Good. Cause it sounds a lot like you tryin’ to take advantage of me again and I thought we were done with that shit.
lines.zh: : 最好不是。因为听起来很像你又想占我便宜，我以为那种事我们早结束了。

lines.en: : We are.
lines.zh: : 是结束了。

lines.en: : You promise?
lines.zh: : 你保证？

lines.en: : Do promises actually mean anything to you?
lines.zh: : 承诺对你来说真的有意义吗？

lines.en: scene chickenscene9
: Not really.
lines.zh: : 算不上有。

lines.en: : When I was still a little brat, not even the same size Chinami is...my douchebag mom promised she’d take me to Okinawa for my birthday.
lines.zh: : 我小时候，还没 Chinami 现在这么大的时候……我那个混蛋老妈答应过我，生日要带我去冲绳。

lines.en: : But she was so fuckin’ high at the time that she probably didn’t even remember makin’ the promise.
lines.zh: : 可她当时嗨得不行，大概连自己做过这个承诺都不记得了。

lines.en: : Least believin’ that makes it easier to accept than her just...decidin’ not to take me once my birthday actually rolled around.
lines.zh: : 至少这么想，比接受「她在我生日真的到了的时候决定不带我去」要好受些。

lines.en: : Haven’t cared much for promises ever since, so I’m not really sure why I asked you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 从那以后我就不怎么信承诺了，所以我也不太明白自己当初为什么要问你。

lines.en: : You were probably just looking for another reason to distrust me. Calling it a promise would make it easier to do that for you.
lines.zh: : 你大概只是想再找个理由不信任我。把它叫「承诺」，你会更容易做到这点。

lines.en: : Probably. Sounds on brand.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。听着挺像我的作风。

lines.en: : Why Okinawa?
lines.zh: : 为什么是冲绳？

lines.en: scene chickenscene10
: Should I not have asked?
lines.zh: : 我不该问吗？

lines.en: : You’ll make fun of me. I don’t wanna tell you.
lines.zh: : 你会笑话我的。我不想告诉你。

lines.en: : I’d promise not to, but then you really wouldn’t want to tell me.
lines.zh: : 我倒可以保证不笑，但那样你就更不想说了。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Do you still want to go?
lines.zh: : 你现在还想去吗？

lines.en: : Can’t. We’ve got that huge ass wall now, remember?
lines.zh: : 去不了。我们现在有那堵巨他妈高的墙了，记得吗？

lines.en: : If the wall was gone and we were able to leave, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果墙没了、我们能出去的话。

lines.en: : Ain’t the first time you asked me somethin’ like that, you know. Happened on the roof.
lines.zh: : 你不是第一次问我这种问题了，知道吗。在屋顶那次也问过。

lines.en: : Shit feels like years ago at this point.
lines.zh: : 现在回想起来，那事简直像发生在几年前。

lines.en: : Maybe it was.
lines.zh: : 也许真的是。

lines.en: : How many birthdays have you had since you joined my class?
lines.zh: : 自从你进了我的班，你过了几个生日？

lines.en: : More than...makes sense.
lines.zh: : 多得……不合常理。

lines.en: : Do you think anyone would call you crazy if you pointed that out?
lines.zh: : 你要是指出来这事，你觉得会有人说你疯了吗？

lines.en: : Probably. It is crazy.
lines.zh: : 大概会。这确实很疯。

lines.en: : Try. Because I guarantee you they won’t think anything of it.
lines.zh: : 试试看。我向你保证，他们不会当回事的。

lines.en: : And up until recently, you would have felt exactly the same as them.
lines.zh: : 而且在不久之前，你的感受会跟他们一模一样。

lines.en: : That is why I’m trying to get you on my side. It has nothing to do with my desire to sleep with you.
lines.zh: : 这就是我想把你拉到我这边的原因。这跟我想睡你一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : The fuck is going on?...
lines.zh: : 到底怎么回事？……

lines.en: : We’re stuck.
lines.zh: : 我们被困住了。

lines.en: : Of course we're stuck. That's the whole fuckin' point of the wall.
lines.zh: : 我们当然被困住了。那堵墙不就是这个意思吗。

lines.en: : Not in Kumon-mi...in time. Which I know sounds ridiculous, but it's the truth.
lines.zh: : 不是被困在 Kumon-mi……是被困在时间。我知道这听起来荒唐，但这是事实。

lines.en: : That ain’t possible. Sounds like...somethin’ from a manga or some shit.
lines.zh: : 那不可能。听起来像……漫画里的情节什么的。

lines.en: : It does, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是吧，听起来确实像。

lines.en: : Sea turtles...
lines.zh: : 海龟……

lines.en: scene chickenscene11
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I wanted to see the sea turtles...in Okinawa.
lines.zh: : 我想看海龟……在冲绳。

lines.en: : There was this documentary I saw on TV where they went to Tokashiku Beach...and I heard them say I’d be able to see one too if I went there at the right time.
lines.zh: : 我在电视上看过一个纪录片，他们去了渡嘉敷海滩……我听他们说，要是在合适的时间去，我也能看到一只。

lines.en: : And even though October ain’t the “right” time...I still thought I might be able to see one if I got lucky or something.
lines.zh: : 虽然十月不是「合适」的时间……我还是想，要是运气好说不定也能看到。

lines.en: : Maybe there was a turtle out there who was behind schedule or...didn’t really understand how months worked or whatever. I don’t know. It’s stupid.
lines.zh: : 也许有只海龟迟到了，或者……不太懂月份是怎么算的什么的。我不知道。很蠢。

lines.en: : I’m stupid.
lines.zh: : 我很蠢。

lines.en: : For havin’ such a...dumb fucking wish...and for trustin’ somebody like my mom to make it happen...
lines.zh: : 蠢在会有这么一个……该死的傻愿望……还蠢在居然相信我妈那种人会帮我实现……

lines.en: : It’s all so fuckin’ stupid.
lines.zh: : 一切都他妈蠢透了。

lines.en: scene chickenscene12
: It’s not.
lines.zh: : 不蠢。

lines.en: : It is. You know it is.
lines.zh: : 就是蠢。你心里清楚。

lines.en: : No, it’s an innocent wish. And not something I would have expected from you.
lines.zh: : 不，这是个天真的愿望。而且我没料到会出自你口中。

lines.en: : I’d take you myself if I could.
lines.zh: : 要是可以的话，我愿意亲自带你去。

lines.en: : Don’t say that...
lines.zh: : 别说这种话……

lines.en: : I mean it, though.
lines.zh: : 可我是认真的。

lines.en: scene chickenscene13
: Me too!
lines.zh: : 我也是认真的！

lines.en: : It’s bad enough bein’ let down by one person! I ain’t gonna get my hopes up a second time just because you wanna be a knight in shining armor!
lines.zh: : 被一个人辜负已经够惨了！我不会因为你想当什么白马骑士就再抱一次希望！

lines.en: : For all we know, we might not ever be able to leave! This city might stay closed forever! You’d be makin’ plans you couldn’t possibly keep!
lines.zh: : 说不定我们永远都出不去！这座城市也许会永远封闭！那你许下的诺言根本就不可能兑现！

lines.en: : I’m done believin’ in other people! I’ll go there myself if I ever have the chance! Not with you! Not with anyone!
lines.zh: : 我再也不信别人了！要是有机会，我自己去！不跟你！不跟任何人！

lines.en: scene chickenscene14
: So you do still want to see them.
lines.zh: : 所以你还是想去看它们。

lines.en: : Of fucking course I do...
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然想啊……

lines.en: : Dreams don’t just go away. They keep comin’ back until you either make ‘em come true or...find somethin’ else you want instead.
lines.zh: : 梦想不会自己消失。它们会一直回来，直到你把它们实现……或者找到别的想要的东西。

lines.en: : So what if I ain’t ever found anything else? And what’s it even matter in the first place? Ain’t like people like me are good at makin’ shit like that come true.
lines.zh: : 那要是我一直没找到别的呢？再说这又有什么意义？像我这种人本来就不擅长让这种事成真。

lines.en: : The fact that there’s anything I want at all is a fuckin’ joke. And if I believed in God, I’m sure he’d tell me the same exact shit.
lines.zh: : 我居然还会想要什么，本身就是个笑话。我要是信上帝，他肯定也会跟我说一模一样的话。

lines.en: : Somethin’ like, “You need to be good to others if you want good things to happen to you,” or whatever the fuck it is that adults tell kids with anger issues ‘stead of actually teachin’ em how to...not be angry.
lines.zh: : 类似「想有好事发生，就得先对别人好」这种话，或者大人拿来敷衍有情绪问题的孩子的那些狗屁——而不是真的教他们……怎么不生气。

lines.en: : Whatever the case...I hope you make it to Okinawa someday.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样……我希望有一天你能去成冲绳。

lines.en: : Thanks, I guess...and sorry for yellin’ at you.
lines.zh: : 谢了，大概吧……还有刚才冲你吼，对不起。

lines.en: : Ain’t ever told anybody that before.
lines.zh: : 这种事我从没跟任何人说过。

lines.en: : Not even Chika?
lines.zh: : 连 Chika 也没说过？

lines.en: : Never came up, I guess...
lines.zh: : 大概是从来没提过吧……

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : I saw her the other day, you know.
lines.zh: : 我前几天见到她了，你知道吗。

lines.en: scene chickenscene15
: Chika?
lines.zh: : Chika？

lines.en: : No, my fucking mom. Idiot.
lines.zh: : 不是，我他妈的妈。白痴。

lines.en: scene chickenscene16
: Though, I guess “the other day” is two months ago at this point.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，现在「前几天」其实已经是两个月前了。

lines.en: : I was stayin’ at my dad’s place for a while since I didn’t have anywhere else to go and...I guess she caught wind of it and showed up.
lines.zh: : 那阵子我住在我爸那儿，因为我没别的地方可去……我猜她听到风声就找来了。

lines.en: : And, honestly...it went...kinda good. She wasn’t pissed that I got kicked out of school and didn’t call me a letdown or any of that shit...
lines.zh: : 说实话……过程……还不错。她没因为我被学校开除而生气，也没说我让她失望什么的……

lines.en: : Just told me I was doin’ a good job and that Nodoka probably deserved what she had comin’ to her. Which she did.
lines.zh: : 只是说我做得不错，还说 Nodoka 大概是罪有应得。她确实是。

lines.en: : Wasn’t just her either. Kaori was there too. Was the first time I talked to her in years.
lines.zh: : 不只有她。Kaori 也在。那是我这么多年来第一次跟她说话。

lines.en: scene chickenscene17
: Did you know it was her birthday on Christmas? How fuckin’ wild is that?
lines.zh: : 你知道她生日是圣诞节吗？他妈的多离谱啊？

lines.en: : People used to talk about how weird it was that we were both born on such big holidays, but I feel like she’s the one who got the short end of the stick, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 以前大家总说我们俩都生在这么大的节日里，很奇怪，不过我觉得总的来说，她才是吃亏的那个。

lines.en: : Ain’t nobody gonna remember someone’s birthday if it’s on fuckin’ Christmas. Halloween’s easy cause it ain’t that big of a deal.
lines.zh: : 生日要是在圣诞节，谁他妈记得住啊。万圣节就轻松多了，因为那不算什么大日子。

lines.en: : What was it like getting to talk to her after so long? Is she anything like you remember?
lines.zh: : 隔了这么久才跟她说上话，是什么感觉？她和你记忆中的她像吗？

lines.en: scene chickenscene18
: She, uhh...
: I was kinda expectin’ it after seein’ her with you that one time, but...she ain’t exactly “all there” anymore.
lines.zh: : 自从那次看到她跟你在一起，我就有点心理准备，不过……她现在确实「不太对劲」了。

lines.en: : Wasn’t ever really normal by any means, but...she’s different now. Don’t think she really remembers me either, which ain’t as hard on me as I expected it to be...but still.
lines.zh: : 她从来就算不上正常，但……她现在不一样了。我觉得她也不太记得我了，这一点没有我想的那么难受……但还是有点。

lines.en: : Kinda surreal seein’ somebody you thought was dead just...suddenly alive and full of energy. Almost too much energy, if you ask me.
lines.zh: : 看到一个你以为已经死了的人，突然活蹦乱跳地出现在面前，感觉挺超现实的。要说的话，她精力简直过剩了。

lines.en: scene chickenscene19
: That is certainly one way to describe her, for sure.
lines.zh: : 这确实是形容她的一种方式，没错。

lines.en: : Do you want her number?
lines.zh: : 你想要她的号码吗？

lines.en: : Kaori’s? Why?
lines.zh: : Kaori 的？为什么？

lines.en: : To talk to her, obviously.
lines.zh: : 当然是方便跟她说话。

lines.en: : I literally just told you she doesn’t remember me.
lines.zh: : 我刚跟你说过她不记得我了。

lines.en: : So remind her. That’s what your mom did and the two of them are relatively close now.
lines.zh: : 那就让她想起来。你妈就是这么做的，现在她们俩关系还挺好的。

lines.en: : Yuki’s just tryin’ to right all the wrongs she made with me by latchin’ onto somebody else who’s lackin’ a mother figure. Does the same shit with Io if what I’ve heard is true.
lines.zh: : Yuki 只是想弥补她对我犯下的错，才去缠上另一个缺母爱的人。我听说她对 Io 也是这套。

lines.en: : Maybe. But I don’t see why that should prevent you from having a relationship with Kaori.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但我不明白为什么这会妨碍你和 Kaori 建立关系。

lines.en: : I don’t need another “relationship.” Chika’s more than enough for me. And that’s not even countin’ whatever the fuck is goin’ on between us.
lines.zh: : 我不需要再多的「关系」了。有 Chika 一个就够了。更别说我们之间那档子破事还没算进去。

lines.en: : What is going on between us?
lines.zh: : 我们之间到底算什么？

lines.en: : Fuckin’...time travel or some shit apparently. Ain’t like I’ve got a fuckin’ clue.
lines.zh: : 他妈的……大概是时间旅行什么的。我他妈怎么知道。

lines.en: : Take her number, Yumi. I’m obviously not one to tell you what is and isn’t good for you, but it’s not like I’m asking you to call her.
lines.zh: : 收下她的号码吧，Yumi。我显然没资格告诉你什么对你好、什么不好，但我又没要求你现在就打给她。

lines.en: : You’ll just...be able to if you ever feel like it.
lines.zh: : 只是……等你想打的时候，你能打得通。

lines.en: scene chickenscene20
: Hah...
: I guess if it’ll get you off my fuckin’ back, I’ll-
lines.zh: : 要这样才能让你别再烦我，那我就——

lines.en: scene chickenscene21
scene chickenscene22
: Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Do you...see that?
lines.zh: : 你……看见那个了吗？

lines.en: : See what?
lines.zh: : 看见什么？

lines.en: : Over there...at the end of the aqueduct.
lines.zh: : 那边……在水渠尽头。

lines.en: : I don’t see-
lines.zh: : 我没看——

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, where are you going?
lines.zh: : 等等，你去哪儿？

lines.en: : To check out what the fuck that is, obviously. Stay here if you’re gonna be a fuckin’ pussy about it.
lines.zh: : 当然是去看看那他妈是什么东西。你要是怂就留在这儿。

lines.en: Yumi takes off toward the end of the aqueduct, and as I lift myself off of the ground to follow her, I notice whatever it is she sees.
lines.zh: Yumi 朝水渠尽头跑去，当我从地上撑起身跟上她时，我也注意到她看见的那个东西了。

lines.en: scene chickenscene23
: How the fuck?...
lines.zh: : 怎么会？……

lines.en: : Since when do we have wild chickens in Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 什么时候有野鸡了？

lines.en: scene chickenscene24
: That’s not a wild chicken...
lines.zh: : 那不是野鸡……

lines.en: : That’s someone’s pet.
lines.zh: : 那是有人养的宠物。
